## City of Malden

Malden City Hall

215 Pleasant Street Malden, MA 02148

## Meeting Minutes - Final License Committee

Councillor Sica, Chair

Councillor Condon, Vice Chair

Councillor Colon Hayes

Councillor Simonelli

Councillor Taylor

Tuesday, May 12, 2026

5:30 PM

215 Pleasant Street

Room 113

Malden, MA 02148

## Watch the meeting with Teams: https://tinyurl.com/ydrf2ejm

## Roll Call

Chair Sica called the meeting to order at 5:31 PM

Also in attendance was Council President Linehan, Compliance Officers Dave Morse and Jim Tuxbury, and Assistant City Clerk Morgan Hunte and Bianca Stallworth of the City Clerk's Office.

Present: 4 - Jadeane Sica, Paul Condon, Chris Simonelli and Amanda Linehan

Absent: 2 - Karen Colon Hayes and Ari Taylor

## Minutes to be Approved

**261-26** 

Minutes for the meeting of April 14, 2026

A motion was made by Councillor Simonelli, seconded by Councillor Condon, that the Committee Minutes be approved. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Business

Chair Sica recused herself during discussion and voting on papers 218 through 223 and 242 through 251 Series of 2026. Council President Linehan sat in as the chair for this portion of the meeting.

The Compliance Officers confirmed there were no issues with any of the following petitions.

**218-26** 

Petition: Open-Air Parking Lot: T.J. Automotive, Corp., 315 Pleasant Street, Malden, 20 spaces (Renewal)

A motion was made by Councillor Simonelli, seconded by Councillor Condon, that the Petition be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Other Business

**84-26** 

Petition: Class II: Malden Auto Center LLC, 189 Eastern Avenue, Malden, 35 vehicles (New)

Councillor Sica returned to the meeting as chair for discussion on Paper 84-26 The Compliance Officers reported that they visited the property and confirmed there weren't any unauthorized vehicles on the lot.

A motion was made by Councillor Simonelli, seconded by Councillor Condon, that the Petition be recommended favorably to the City Council to extend the 90-day license for the remainder of the calendar year expiring on December 31, 2026. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Adjournment

A motion was made by Councillor Simonelli, seconded by Councillor Condon, that the meeting be adjourned. The motion carried by a unanimous vote. The meeting adjourned at 5:38 PM

headline: Recommended seventeen license and permit petitions favorably to the City Council, all by unanimous votes.
summary: The committee reviewed renewal petitions for parking lots, pool tables, a pawnbroker, second-hand dealers, gas stations, a bowling alley, a vending machine, livery services, and a lodging house, and recommended each one favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote. It also recommended favorably extending a Class II license for Malden Auto Center LLC through December 31, 2026.
